components.name: Play Button
components.description: Primary start-game / matchmaking CTA in Play Amber.
components.css: .ds-btn-play { background: var(--color-accent, oklch(0.70 0.14 70)); color: var(--color-surface, oklch(0.22 0.015 65)); font-family: var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans Thai", sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 100ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-play:hover { background: oklch(0.72 0.15 75); } .ds-btn-play:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.58 0.16 135 / 0.2); }

components.name: Primary Soft Button
components.description: Secondary emphasis with translucent Lacquer Green wash — not the main Play path.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-soft { border-radius: 0.6rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)) 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)) 18%, transparent); color: var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); font-family: var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans Thai", sans-serif); font-weight: 700; padding: 8px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary-soft:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)) 24%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)) 42%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary-soft:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet chrome control on cloth — cancel, lang toggle, mobile nav items.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Cloth-surface field with Lacquer Green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans Thai", sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-dim, oklch(0.68 0.015 65)); } .ds-input { background: var(--color-surface, oklch(0.22 0.015 65)); color: var(--color-text-bright, oklch(0.90 0.01 65)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-surface-hover, oklch(0.26 0.015 65)) 78%, transparent); border-radius: 0.6rem; padding: 8px 12px; font: inherit; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.58 0.16 135 / 0.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-dim, oklch(0.68 0.015 65)); }

components.name: Site Nav Link
components.description: Header text link with Lacquer Green active underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Primary"><button type="button" class="ds-nav-link">Play</button><button type="button" class="ds-nav-link is-active">Puzzles</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans Thai", sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-dim, oklch(0.68 0.015 65)); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-text-bright, oklch(0.90 0.01 65)); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -10px; height: 2px; background: var(--color-primary, oklch(0.58 0.16 135)); border-radius: 999px; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Time Control Chip
components.description: Selectable time-control preset on Quick Play setup.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-surface-hover, oklch(0.26 0.015 65)) 78%, transparent); background: var(--color-surface, oklch(0.22 0.015 65)); color: var(--color-text-bright, oklch(0.90 0.01 65)); font-family: var(--font-body, "IBM Plex Sans Thai", sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover, oklch(0.26 0.015 65)); } .ds-chip.is-selected { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent, oklch(0.70 0.14 70)) 18%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent, oklch(0.70 0.14 70)) 45%, transparent); color: var(--color-text-bright, oklch(0.90 0.01 65)); font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary-light, oklch(0.66 0.18 135)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
ThaiChess sits on a warm cloth-dark table — isotropic felt noise over ember-tinted neutrals — so the Makruk board and pieces read as the light source, not a SaaS dashboard chrome stack. The room is quiet: soft tonal steps, restrained borders, and motion that respects prefers-reduced-motion. Personality is curious and welcoming without elitism; tradition shows up in material and stroke discipline, not ornamental gold.

Action is amber. Antique gold is rare on purpose — it signals turn, check, and puzzle-solved only. Lacquer green remains for legacy chrome (nav active, soft primary washes, focus rings) but does not compete with Play Amber for “start a game.” Icons share the Bia (เบี้ย) stroke ratio so chrome and pieces feel like one family.
keyCharacteristics: Cloth-dark felt surfaces (never pure black; never chess.com wood as app chrome)
Play Amber for CTAs; State Gold reserved for three game states
Display Chakra Petch + body IBM Plex Sans Thai (Thai-first stacks)
Flat-by-default elevation; board and menus lift sparingly
Tactile board-first: chrome recedes; pieces and board carry weight

rules.name: The Gold-Is-State Rule
rules.body: State Gold appears only for active turn, check pulse, and puzzle-solved. Never on buttons, nav, or badges.

rules.name: The Cloth-Not-Wood Rule
rules.body: App chrome is felt dusk. Wood/jade/ivory board themes are player board skins, not the product shell.

rules.name: The One Play Voice Rule
rules.body: Starting a game uses Play Amber (or solid accent fills). Do not promote Lacquer Green to the primary play CTA on home/marketing surfaces.

rules.name: The Thai-First Stack Rule
rules.body: Always keep Thai-capable fallbacks in the body stack; do not ship Latin-only body fonts as the sole face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadows appear for board presence, open menus, drag, or focus — not for every card.

rules.name: The Soft-Corner Rule
rules.body: Prefer 0.6–0.9rem radii for chrome; reserve sharp 4px only for dense in-game chips (e.g. active move highlight).

dos: Do put Play Amber on start-game / matchmaking CTAs.
Do keep State Gold limited to turn, check, and puzzle-solved.
Do preserve cloth felt noise and warm-tinted neutrals (never pure #000 / pure gray text).
Do use Chakra Petch for display moments and IBM Plex Sans Thai for UI/body.
Do let the board bleed or dominate play surfaces; chrome stays subordinate.
donts: Don't use gold on buttons, nav, badges, or marketing chrome.
Don't restyle the app shell as wood/stone to “look like chess sites.”
Don't invent purple SaaS gradients or glow-heavy dashboard cards as the default look.
Don't drop Thai font fallbacks from the body stack.
Don't ignore prefers-reduced-motion for check pulse, hero fade, or piece motion.
